scope: refgraph.py whole read; pin verified; extracted original classes tested without sizing or rendering backend

control_result.scope: Exact AST classes; synthetic edges and actual in-memory gc referents, no original imports or Graph constructor/Asizer/Graphviz

edge_hash_collision.note: Synthetic integer IDs demonstrate equality contract; no claim of observed live object-id collision

findings: Edge equality compares hash values instead of endpoint/label tuples. Synthetic integer collision reproduced; not a measured live object ID collision.
Leaf elimination retains nodes leading into cycles, not just nodes participating in cycles. One predecessor plus one self-cycle retained as two cycle nodes.
One-pass group propagation splits a connected four-node graph into two labels, dependent on object ordering.
Graph traversal and rendering lack explicit node/edge/time budgets; subprocess communicate has no timeout. No renderer launched.
Object id is identity for object references, not file-content equality. No production deduplication code copied.
